falsifiable_hypothesis: A lineage permitted to modify the mechanism that turns evidence into candidate transformations will, after meeting a limitation that mechanism cannot express, construct and adopt a validated modification of it; and on a later independently frozen problem the modified mechanism will generate a corrective transformation lying outside the constructive image of the original mechanism, producing a correct outcome that the same lineage with a frozen mechanism does not reach under any budget.

the_frozen_thing_being_attacked.line: ModuleDiagnosis.sufficient returns self.module is not None
the_frozen_thing_being_attacked.meaning: a diagnosis is usable only when exactly one module is at fault
the_frozen_thing_being_attacked.consequence: multi-module evidence yields ModuleDiagnosis(None, ...), the engine returns INSUFFICIENT_DIAGNOSIS, and no candidate is generated at all
the_frozen_thing_being_attacked.generator: metamorphosis/m047_search_templates.py::_candidate_sources dispatches on that single module through an authored if/elif chain over five module names
the_frozen_thing_being_attacked.already_recorded_by_m047: faced a compound maximum task requiring simultaneous interpreter, selection and new-tool changes beyond the one-boundary proposal surface, and terminated for insufficient evidence

mutable_artifact.name: improvement_mechanism
mutable_artifact.why_the_interpreter_is_not_mutable: it stands to the rule set as a CPU stands to a program; what the lineage rewrites is the schema and the rules, and the next cycle really executes the rewritten version
mutable_artifact.why: without it, making the mechanism mutable would be a claim about a new mechanism we wrote rather than about the one the repository froze

the sandbox and the disposability rules
the transaction, checkpoint and rollback machinery
the task bank and the holdout

meta_primitives.authored_like: M046's transformation language and M047's templates

primary_outcome.measure: the holdout is solved: the adopted body passes the evaluator's hidden cases in a disposable sandbox
primary_outcome.why: M084's ablation cost efficiency and not capability, and its status file says a claim resting on that would be weak

failure_classification.negative: any of P1 to P10 false; fixed_meta solving the holdout would refute the capability claim outright and is the most informative outcome available
failure_classification.inconclusive: the sandbox cannot run; not runnable is not negative
failure_classification.positive: every one of P1 to P10 true on the first materialized bank, with no retry

named_negative_outcomes: the limitation was expressible after all, so our reading of sufficient was wrong
the meta-primitives are the new frozen ceiling: nothing reachable from them validates, moving the human assumption up one level rather than removing it
the adopted change is inert: adopted, but the later success does not use it
the ablation leaks: meta_acquisition_ablated solves it too, so the body or memory carried what we attributed to the mechanism
selection was ours: the primitive that works is the only one that could ever have worked, making the search a disguised lookup

hyperagents.question_taken: whether the improvement mechanism can itself be improved
hyperagents.method_refused: a frontier model proposes the modification, which under this repository's attribution rule makes the competence the composed system's
hyperagents.why_not: introducing them together would make a positive result causally unattributable

prohibited_adaptation: let a foundation model write, choose or rank the mechanism modification and still call it Track A

enumerate finished meta-transformations in the primitive set
add a rule mapping an evidence pattern directly to the primitive that works
materialize the holdout before the meta-transformation is committed
make a cost metric decisive after seeing that correctness did not separate
add an archive, a population or parent selection after observing the result
claim any generality gate, open-ended evolution or arbitrary self-improvement
change the hypothesis, thresholds, salt, primitives or task grammar after bank materialization

amendments.discovered_by: construction runs on the unbound bank
amendments.change: P6 is tested as 'the adopted holdout patch is not in M0's constructive image for the holdout evidence' rather than 'is emitted by a rule absent from M0's rule list'
amendments.reason: the lock turned out to be the hypothesis schema, not the rule inventory. Widening the schema alone lets an existing rule fire on evidence M0 refuses to speak about, so the successful patch uses a rule M0 lists but could never have produced. The clause the protocol states in the same sentence — lying outside the constructive image — is unchanged, still decisive and still provable by enumeration.
amendments.note: that composition proved unnecessary is a finding and is reported as one: three of the four meta-primitives were rejected and the minimal sufficient change was adopted.

amendments.discovered_by: construction runs on the unbound bank
amendments.change: each limitation pairs an unparseable token whose canonical operation already has a route, and the routeless operation is never `max`
amendments.reason: an earlier bank aliased tokens onto routeless operations, so repairing the alias revealed a new missing route and the greedy tie-break locked in a wrong alias no later cycle could diagnose; and M047's render_tool_module emits a self-recursive `def max` for a tool named `max`, shadowing the builtin its expression needs. Both are properties of the bank and of a qualified renderer, not of the hypothesis under test.
